steps.en: Add the tour package to your React app
steps.zh: 给 React 应用装上引导包

steps.en: Wrap the app root with the provider, passing steps: which element, what to say
steps.zh: 用 provider 包住应用根部，传入步骤：指哪个元素、说什么

steps.en: From any component, open the tour through the hook
steps.zh: 在任意组件里通过 hook 打开引导

steps.en: Finds the element, dims the page around it and shows the popover beside it
steps.zh: 找到元素，把周围压暗，在旁边弹出说明卡片

steps.en: Moves between steps on buttons, dots and arrow keys, keeping focus in the popover
steps.zh: 随按钮、圆点和方向键切换步骤，焦点锁在卡片里

value.en: A guided tour that lives in React state and points users at the exact element, not a help page
value.zh: 一段放在 React 状态里的引导，直接把用户指到那个元素上，而不是丢给他一篇帮助文档

sources: https://github.com/elrumordelaluz/reactour/tree/main/packages/tour#readme (Install: npm i -S @reactour/tour; Usage: <TourProvider steps={steps}>, selector: '.first-step', const { setIsOpen } = useTour(); props disableFocusLock, disableKeyboardNavigation 'esc' | 'left' | 'right', disableDotsNavigation)
https://github.com/elrumordelaluz/reactour#readme (Packages: @reactour/tour uses @reactour/mask to highlight and @reactour/popover to show content)
